name: Manufacturing Support Utility Maintenance Combination
trigger_logic: manufacturing or industrial asset family active
anti_triggers: power factor or tariff exposure already falsified
combined_hypothesis: The visible energy problem may be a support-utility and maintenance problem before it is a generic production-efficiency problem.
strategic_risk: Capital can target production-side replacement while the real value leak remains in support-utility management, maintenance discipline and hidden tariff exposure.
prohibited_claims: roi claim without maintenance and tariff discrimination
allowed_language: A bounded strategic framing is admissible: the economics may sit in support-utility control, maintenance discipline and tariff exposure before production-side CAPEX.
falsification: compressed-air losses immaterial, maintenance maturity evidenced, AND tariff/power-quality exposure quantified — all three independently.
tests: manufacturing bundles should surface this combination when compressed air, maintenance and reactive exposure remain unresolved
combination must require run-level adjudication before downstream strategic use
